name: Translucent Red Slime
codex: Translucent slimes are considered the weakest of the slime family, having relatively fragile cores that make them easy to defeat. Red slimes are known for physically attacking their prey before slowly digesting it.

attacks.name: Pseudopod Strike
attacks.prep_text: Translucent Red Slime reaches back to strike...

attacks.name: Slime Stomp
attacks.prep_text: Translucent Red Slime squashes down for a jump...

name: Translucent Blue Slime
codex: Translucent slimes are considered the weakest of the slime family, having relatively fragile cores that make them easy to defeat. Blue slimes are known for a small mastery of water elemental magic and prefer attacking from range.

attacks.name: Water Jet
attacks.prep_text: Translucent Blue Slime starts to bubble violently...

attacks.name: Water Slash
attacks.prep_text: Translucent Blue Slime swirls water around inside itself...

name: Dungeon Bat
codex: Dungeon bats are the larger and madder cousin of the typical bat. They attack mostly by biting their opponents, but the more dangerous ones have been seen manipulating Wind Magic.

attacks.name: Bite
attacks.prep_text: Dungeon Bat bares its fangs...

attacks.name: Wind Slash
attacks.prep_text: A whirl of wind kicks up around Dungeon Bat...

name: Dungeon Rat
codex: Dungeon rats are the larger and madder cousin of the typical rat. They attack mostly by biting their opponents, but have been known to scratch with their claws.

attacks.name: Bite
attacks.prep_text: Dungeon Rat bares its fangs...

attacks.name: Scratch
attacks.prep_text: Dungeon Rat readies its claws...

name: Rock Lizard
codex: These large lizards are distant cousins of salamanders, aligned with earth. They have thick scales made of stone and possess control of Earth Magic.

attacks.name: Bite
attacks.prep_text: Rock Lizard bares its fangs...

attacks.name: Tremor
attacks.prep_text: The ground at Rock Lizard's feet begins to shake...

name: Cave Spider
codex: Cave spiders lurk in the corners of dark passages, waiting for prey to stumble into their webs. Their bite is painful, and older spiders weave threads laced with shadow that sap the strength of anything caught in them.

attacks.name: Bite
attacks.prep_text: Cave Spider rears up on its hind legs...

attacks.name: Shadow Web
attacks.prep_text: Cave Spider begins spinning strands of inky silk...

name: Ember Beetle
codex: Ember beetles nest near underground heat vents, and their shells stay warm to the touch long after death. They snap at intruders with their mandibles and can spit globs of smoldering ash.

attacks.name: Mandible Snap
attacks.prep_text: Ember Beetle clicks its mandibles together...

attacks.name: Ember Spit
attacks.prep_text: Smoke begins to curl from Ember Beetle's jaws...

name: Goblin Scout
codex: Goblin scouts range ahead of their warbands, picking off stragglers. They carry little more than a rusty dagger and a pouch of rocks, but they are not shy about using both.

attacks.name: Rusty Dagger
attacks.prep_text: Goblin Scout crouches low, dagger in hand...

attacks.name: Thrown Rock
attacks.prep_text: Goblin Scout winds up a throw...

name: Lantern Moth
codex: Lantern moths glow with a soft inner light that lures travelers deeper into the dungeon. When threatened, they beat their great wings to stir up gusts and shed dust that flashes blindingly bright.

attacks.name: Wing Buffet
attacks.prep_text: Lantern Moth spreads its wings wide...

attacks.name: Blinding Dust
attacks.prep_text: Lantern Moth's glow grows steadily brighter...

name: Mud Golem
codex: Mud golems are crude constructs left behind by apprentice mages, still following orders no one remembers giving. They are slow but sturdy, pounding foes with heavy fists or hurling clumps of their own earthen bodies.

attacks.name: Mud Fist
attacks.prep_text: Mud Golem slowly raises a dripping fist...

attacks.name: Mud Hurl
attacks.prep_text: Mud Golem tears a clump of earth from its chest...

name: Opaque Green Slime
codex: Opaque slimes have denser cores than their translucent cousins, making them noticeably harder to destroy. Green slimes slam into their prey with surprising force and can expel bursts of pressurized air from within.

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.prep_text: Opaque Green Slime compresses itself into a tight ball...

attacks.name: Gale Burst
attacks.prep_text: Opaque Green Slime begins to swell with air...

name: Skeleton Warrior
codex: The bones of fallen adventurers, raised to guard the dungeon they died in. Skeleton warriors remember the basics of swordplay and fight with a notched blade and a battered shield.

attacks.name: Bone Sword
attacks.prep_text: Skeleton Warrior raises its notched blade...

attacks.name: Shield Bash
attacks.prep_text: Skeleton Warrior hunches behind its shield...

name: Will-o'-Wisp
codex: Wisps are drifting motes of spirit energy that feed on the fear of the lost. They have no body to strike, instead lashing out with darting bolts of light and ghostly flame.

attacks.name: Flicker Bolt
attacks.prep_text: Will-o'-Wisp flickers erratically...

attacks.name: Spirit Flame
attacks.prep_text: Will-o'-Wisp flares a sickly blue...

name: Goblin Shaman
codex: Goblin shamans hold the warband together with superstition and a little real magic. They will whack anyone who gets too close with their staff, but their true danger is the fire they call down from afar.

attacks.name: Staff Whack
attacks.prep_text: Goblin Shaman grips its staff with both hands...

attacks.name: Firebolt
attacks.prep_text: Goblin Shaman begins chanting, sparks dancing on its fingertips...

name: Stone Gargoyle
codex: Gargoyles perch motionless among carved statues until prey passes beneath. They rake with stone claws, beat up gusts with their heavy wings, and drop from above with crushing force.

attacks.name: Claw Rake
attacks.prep_text: Stone Gargoyle flexes its granite claws...

attacks.name: Wing Gust
attacks.prep_text: Stone Gargoyle unfurls its heavy wings...

attacks.name: Stone Dive
attacks.prep_text: Stone Gargoyle launches itself high into the air...

name: Shadow Wolf
codex: Shadow wolves hunt the deepest levels of the dungeon, their dark fur nearly invisible against the gloom. They bite like any wolf, but can also melt into the darkness and strike from an unexpected angle.

attacks.name: Bite
attacks.prep_text: Shadow Wolf bares its fangs with a low growl...

attacks.name: Shadow Pounce
attacks.prep_text: Shadow Wolf fades into the surrounding darkness...

name: Tide Crab
codex: Tide crabs thrive in the flooded caverns beneath the dungeon. Their massive pincers can crush armor, and they spray jets of brackish water to keep attackers at bay.

attacks.name: Pincer Crush
attacks.prep_text: Tide Crab opens its massive pincer...

attacks.name: Bubble Spray
attacks.prep_text: Tide Crab begins frothing at the mouth...

name: Orc Brute
codex: Orc brutes rely on raw strength rather than skill. They swing a massive club with little warning beyond a grunt, and when the club isn't enough, they simply charge headfirst.

attacks.name: Club Smash
attacks.prep_text: Orc Brute hoists its club overhead...

attacks.name: Headbutt
attacks.prep_text: Orc Brute lowers its head and snorts...

name: Fire Imp
codex: Fire imps are small, mischievous fiends that delight in causing pain. They jab at foes with tiny pitchforks and hurl balls of hellfire, cackling all the while.

attacks.name: Pitchfork Jab
attacks.prep_text: Fire Imp twirls its pitchfork with a cackle...

attacks.name: Fireball
attacks.prep_text: Fire Imp cups a growing ball of flame in its hands...

name: Banshee
codex: Banshees are the restless spirits of those who died in despair. Their mournful wail tears at the soul, their touch carries the chill of the grave, and the air around them howls with icy wind.

attacks.name: Mournful Wail
attacks.prep_text: Banshee draws in a long, rattling breath...

attacks.name: Grave Wind
attacks.prep_text: A freezing wind begins to swirl around Banshee...

attacks.name: Spectral Touch
attacks.prep_text: Banshee reaches out with a translucent hand...

name: Ironshell Beetle
codex: Ironshell beetles grow carapaces as hard as forged steel by feeding on ore veins. They charge with their great horns and can burrow through solid rock to strike from below.

attacks.name: Horn Charge
attacks.prep_text: Ironshell Beetle scrapes its legs against the floor...

attacks.name: Burrow Strike
attacks.prep_text: Ironshell Beetle digs rapidly into the ground...

name: Cultist Initiate
codex: Robed initiates of a forbidden cult, sent into the depths to prove their devotion. They are quick with a ritual dagger and have begun to learn the darker arts of their order.

attacks.name: Ritual Dagger
attacks.prep_text: Cultist Initiate draws a curved dagger from its robes...

attacks.name: Dark Bolt
attacks.prep_text: Cultist Initiate whispers a forbidden incantation...

name: Fallen Knight
codex: Once sworn protectors of the realm, fallen knights now serve whatever darkness claimed them. Their swordsmanship is still flawless, and their shield is as much a weapon as their blade.

attacks.name: Longsword Slash
attacks.prep_text: Fallen Knight raises its longsword into a high guard...

attacks.name: Shield Bash
attacks.prep_text: Fallen Knight braces behind its tower shield...

name: Storm Harpy
codex: Storm harpies nest in the high vaulted chambers of the dungeon, diving on anything below. They rake with razor talons, and their piercing shriek can summon a howling tempest.

attacks.name: Talon Rake
attacks.prep_text: Storm Harpy circles overhead, talons extended...

attacks.name: Tempest Shriek
attacks.prep_text: Storm Harpy throws back its head as the wind picks up...

name: Crystal Golem
codex: Crystal golems are animated by the raw magic trapped inside their gemstone bodies. They pummel foes with crystalline fists, focus light into searing beams, and shatter shards of themselves into deadly storms.

attacks.name: Crystal Fist
attacks.prep_text: Crystal Golem draws back a glittering fist...

attacks.name: Shard Storm
attacks.prep_text: Cracks spread across Crystal Golem's body...

attacks.name: Prism Beam
attacks.prep_text: Light gathers and refracts within Crystal Golem's core...
